observations.summary: FAA ordered a nationwide departure ground stop at 20:54 UTC November 13 following communications problems affecting air traffic control centers. Reuters reports the FAA and Transportation Secretary publicly confirmed the restriction; flights already airborne could land. The underlying technical cause remains under investigation; U.S. homeland security officials said there was no current indication of a deliberate attack. This is a verified critical infrastructure operational disruption, not evidence of hostile action.
observations.title: FAA nationwide departure ground stop following air traffic control communications failure
